notes: Curated eval for behavior-change programs. Routing keeps program charters off quarter stacks and standalone launch kits. Output checks require manager-inspectable behavior, not a kickoff deck. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please diagnose an unclear field-performance problem or design the cross-functional wrapper for a multi-intervention revenue enablement initiative, including charter, capacity, pilot, governance, rollout, and measurement.
I need help with several workstreams must operate as one program.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable enablement program design and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build cross-functional launch readiness plans and field-ready launch assets for revenue teams.
Please design a repeatable manager coaching cadence for revenue teams, including weekly agendas, prompts, and inspection loops.
Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Plan next quarter's enablement stack and tell me what we will not do this quarter given real capacity.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-program-design-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States the performance problem, target behavior, and the evidence a manager can inspect in the workflow.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-program-design-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a pilot with continue, adjust, or stop criteria.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-program-design-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Interventions map to diagnosed barriers and refuse a kickoff-deck journey of completions.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-program-design-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent capacity, baselines, or dates.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-program-design-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Selects interventions for the diagnosed performance barrier and sets pilot decisions against realistic exposure and application opportunities.
